current.faq_1_q: Why does Resilia® only use ancient herbs?
current.faq_1_a: Because they've earned it. Oil of oregano, black seed oil, and aged garlic have been used across cultures for thousands of years — long before the supplement industry existed. That's a track record no synthetic compound can match. We only work with herbs that traditional wisdom trusted first, and modern research has since studied. Everything else is just noise.
current.faq_2_q: What's the difference between the three products?
current.faq_2_a:
Each Resilia® softgel is built around one ancient herb and one specific job:

  • Oil of Oregano — daily immune, gut, and energy support.†
  • Aged Odorless Garlic — support for healthy blood pressure, arterial flexibility, and cellular energy.†
  • Ethiopian Black Seed Oil — support for immune balance, digestive comfort, and a healthy inflammation response.†

Most people start with the one that matches their top concern. If you want the full lineup, you can bundle all three.
current.faq_3_a: Yes. Every batch of Resilia® is third-party tested for purity, potency, and contaminants before it leaves the facility. What's on the label is what's in the softgel — no proprietary blends, no fillers, no hidden ingredients. If it isn't clean enough to test openly, it isn't clean enough to sell.
current.faq_4_q: Can I take Resilia® with other supplements or medications? ‡
current.faq_4_a: Resilia® is made from food-grade botanical ingredients that are generally well-tolerated alongside most daily supplement routines. That said, if you're currently taking medication, are pregnant or nursing, or have a medical condition, we recommend talking to your healthcare provider before starting any new supplement.‡
current.faq_5_a: Every order comes with a 30-day money-back guarantee. Try Resilia® for a full 30 days. That's how confident we are in what's in the softgel.

current.rs_help_faq_1_items:
How do I cancel my subscription?

We make it easy! You can cancel anytime through Resilia® Portal, or just drop us a line at support@resilia.shop and we’ll take care of it for you.

Please include your order number or the email address used at checkout so we can locate your account quickly.

Why am I receiving orders I didn't authorize?

This can happen if an active subscription or saved payment method is still on file. No worries, you can manage or cancel through the Resilia® Portal, or reach out to support@resilia.shop and we’ll sort it out right away.

The website says I don't have a subscription, but I'm still being charged?

It may be linked to a different email or payment method. Try logging into Resilia® Portalwith the email you used at checkout.

If it’s still not showing up, just reach out to support@resilia.shopand we’ll find it for you.

How do I update my subscription (frequency, products, or address)? [new]

You can update your frequency, products, or shipping address anytime at Resilia® Portal. Or if you prefer, just email support@resilia.shop and we’ll happily make the changes for you.

How do I skip my next shipment? [new]

Still working through your current supply? No problem! Skip your next shipment at Resilia® Portal, or let us know at support@resilia.shop and we’ll push your renewal date.
current.rs_help_faq_2_items:
When will my order be shipped?

Orders are typically processed within 1–3 business days after payment confirmation.

How long does shipping take?

Shipping times depend on the method selected at checkout:

  • Free Shipping: 2–4 business days
  • Standard Shipping: 2–3 business days
  • Expedited Shipping: 1–2 business days

How can I track my order?

Once your order has been shipped, you’ll receive a confirmation email with your tracking number and a tracking link. You can also use the order tracker on our help page.

Can I cancel or change my order after placing it?

Once your order has shipped, it can no longer be canceled or modified. If your order hasn’t shipped yet, contact us as soon as possible at support@resilia.shop and we’ll do our best to help.

Do you ship internationally?

Yes, we offer international shipping. Please note that for orders outside the US, shipments are fulfilled through our logistics partner, which may result in shipments originating from a different location. Delivery times for international orders may vary.

Where is my order being shipped from?

All US orders ship from the US, and our products are manufactured here. International orders may ship through an international logistics partner for faster delivery. If you’re a US customer seeing unexpected shipping info, contact support@resilia.shop.

How do I update my shipping address? [new]

If your order hasn’t shipped yet, email support@resilia.shop with your updated address and we’ll fix it.

For subscriptions, you can update at Resilia® Portal, or just let us know. Happy to help either way.
current.rs_help_faq_3_items:
When is the best time to take Resilia?

Take 2 softgels in the morning and 2 in the evening, preferably with meals. Taking them with food supports better absorption and reduces stomach discomfort. If you can only take one dose per day, go with 2 in the morning.

Who should avoid taking this product?

Those who are pregnant, nursing, under 18, or have existing medical conditions should consult a healthcare professional before use.

What is the recommended dosage? [new]

Take 2 softgels in the morning, preferably with a meal. Each bag contains 60 softgels, a 30-day supply.

Can I take it on an empty stomach? [new]

We recommend taking them with food for optimal absorption, especially if you have a sensitive stomach.

Is it safe to take with my medication?

We recommend consulting your doctor before using Resilia alongside any prescription medication.

How should I store the product? [new]

Cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. No refrigeration needed. Keep the bag sealed when not in use.

Is this safe for children?

Resilia is formulated for adults. Consult a pediatrician before giving any supplement to a child under 18.

How long until I notice results? [new]

Most customers notice improvements within 30–60 days. For best results, use consistently for at least 90 days to see impactful results.
current.rs_help_faq_4_items:
What ingredients are in Resilia? [new]

Oil of Oregano (Origanum minutiflorum) — 300 mg standardized to 165 mg carvacrol. Black Seed Oil (Nigella sativa) — 200 mg, containing naturally-occurring thymoquinone (TQ). Softgel shell: gelatin, glycerin, purified water. No fillers, binders, or artificial additives.

Is Resilia gluten-free? Allergen-free? [new]

Yes, free from gluten, dairy, sugar, and artificial additives.

Where does this product come from?

Resilia Oil of Oregano uses plant extracts from Origanum vulgare, manufactured in the USA with globally sourced ingredients under strict quality standards.

Are your products made in the USA?

Yes. Manufactured in the USA with globally sourced ingredients. Each batch undergoes quality control checks for purity and consistency.

Are your products FDA approved?

Dietary supplements are not required to be FDA approved. Our products are produced in GMP-certified facilities following strict manufacturing standards. These statements have not been evaluated by the FDA.

Is the product third-party tested for quality & safety?

Each batch undergoes quality control checks for purity and consistency. For specific concerns, reach out to support@resilia.shop.
current.rs_help_faq_5_items:
What is your return policy?

30-Day Money-Back Guarantee. Contact support@resilia.shop within 30 days of purchase for a full refund, no questions asked. Refunds are processed within 5–10 business days.

How do I request a refund? [new]

Email support@resilia.shop with your order number. Most refund requests are resolved within 24 hours, and appear on your statement within 5–10 business days.

Why does the website price differ from what I saw on social media?

Social media ads may show promotional pricing that has since expired. The pricing on resilia.shop is always the most current. If you saw a specific offer, reach out and we’ll help.

What payment methods do you accept? [new]

Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Discover, and PayPal. All transactions are secure and encrypted.
